Keybinding.Name: Loot or steal from target
Keybinding.Hint: Loot the targeted dead token, or attempt to steal from the targeted living token.

tierMenu.Name: Loot tables & tiers
tierMenu.Label: Configure tiers
tierMenu.Hint: Set the default loot table and stronger tables for more powerful creatures.

maxDistance.Name: Interaction range
maxDistance.Hint: Maximum distance (in scene units) between your token and the target. 0 disables the range check.

doubleClick.Name: Double-click to loot
doubleClick.Hint: Let players double-click NPC tokens they do not own to loot or steal. Uses a best-effort patch; the keybinding always works.

useDeadStatus.Name: Dead status counts as dead
useDeadStatus.Hint: Tokens with the defeated/dead status can be looted.

useZeroHp.Name: 0 HP counts as dead
useZeroHp.Hint: Tokens at 0 HP or less can be looted.

lootCheckEnabled.Name: Require a check to loot
lootCheckEnabled.Hint: Players must pass a skill check (Investigation in D&D 5e) to loot. Can be overridden per token.

lootCheckDc.Name: Default loot DC
lootCheckDc.Hint: Used when neither the token nor its tier sets a DC.

lootRetry.Name: Allow retrying failed loot checks
lootRetry.Hint: When off, a player who fails the loot check cannot try that token again.

stealDefaultDc.Name: Fallback steal DC
stealDefaultDc.Hint: Used when the target has no passive Perception and no fixed DC.

stealLimit.Name: Items per successful steal
stealLimit.Hint: How many loot rows a thief may take after one successful check.

consequence.Name: Failed steal consequence
consequence.Hint: What happens when a steal attempt fails. Can be overridden per token.

retryLock.Name: Lock after a noticed steal
retryLock.Hint: A player who is noticed cannot try to steal from that token again.

marginEscalation.Name: Failing by 5+ is always noticed
marginEscalation.Hint: A silent failure becomes noticed when the check misses by 5 or more.

combatPrompt.Name: Combat prompt
combatPrompt.Hint: With the hostile consequence, whisper the GM a suggestion to start combat.

trashPermission.Name: Who may trash loot
trashPermission.Hint: Trash removes all remaining loot from a token.
trashPermission.everyone: Everyone with the loot window open

trashQuest.Name: Trash removes quest items
trashQuest.Hint: When off, quest items (secondary table and items, special inventory) survive trashing.

removeEmpty.Name: Empty dead tokens
removeEmpty.Hint: What to do with a dead token once all its loot is gone.

powerPath.Name: Data path: creature power
powerPath.Hint: Actor data path used to pick a tier (D&D 5e: system.details.cr).

typePath.Name: Data path: creature type
typePath.Hint: Actor data path for the creature type used by typed tiers.

hpPath.Name: Data path: hit points
hpPath.Hint: Actor data path for current HP (used by the 0 HP rule).

passivePath.Name: Data path: passive Perception
passivePath.Hint: Actor data path for the target's passive Perception (steal DC).

lootSkill.Name: Loot skill
lootSkill.Hint: Skill key rolled to loot (D&D 5e: inv).

stealSkill.Name: Steal skill
stealSkill.Hint: Skill key rolled to steal (D&D 5e: slt).

skillModPath.Name: Data path: skill modifier
skillModPath.Hint: Fallback when the system has no skill roll API. {skill} is replaced by the skill key; 1d20 + this value is rolled.

currencyPath.Name: Data path: currency
currencyPath.Hint: Actor data path of the currency object (D&D 5e: system.currency).

denominations.Name: Currency denominations
denominations.Hint: Comma-separated denominations recognised in table results such as "2d6 gp".

quantityPath.Name: Data path: item quantity
quantityPath.Hint: Item data path for stack quantity.

Tiers.Title: Loot tables & tiers
Tiers.Hint: The first matching rule wins: token table → actor table → tier → default table. Min and max are inclusive; leave empty for no bound. A tier with a creature type is preferred over an untyped one.

Config.TokenHint: Settings for this placed token. Empty fields inherit from the actor's prototype token, then the global settings.
Config.PrototypeHint: Defaults for every token of this actor. Empty fields inherit from the global settings.
Config.InventoryHint: Items in this token's inventory that its actor does not normally carry are lootable too, as are items flagged as loot.
Config.NotRolled: Not rolled yet; rolls on the first successful loot or steal.

Window.TrashConfirm: Throw away everything left on {name}? This cannot be undone.

Notify.ItemPiles: Interactive Looting: Item Piles is also active. Both modules may react to the same tokens.

Chat.CombatPrompt: {user} was caught stealing from {target}, who is now hostile. Start combat?

Error.unknownSkill: Your character has no skill "{skill}". Ask the GM to check the skill setting in Interactive Looting.
Error.noToken: You need a token on this scene.
Error.noActor: You have no character to act with.
Error.noSkill: No skill is configured for this check.
Error.stateChanged: The situation has changed. Try again.
Error.notGranted: You have not earned access to this loot.
Error.stealLimit: You cannot take that many items.
Error.trashNotAllowed: You are not allowed to trash loot.
Error.internal: Something went wrong. See the GM's console.
